capabilities: Upload images via drag, paste, right-click, or command
Rehost remote images by fetching external links and replacing them
Batch upload and rewrite all image links in the current note
Configure upload channels such as Telegram, Cloudflare R2, S3, Discord, HuggingFace, and WebDAV
Watch folders or the whole vault to auto-upload images on note changes
extras: README is mostly Chinese with an English section; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; troubleshooting section covers upload failures and broken image links; author accepts donations via PayPal, ko-fi, WeChat, and Alipay.
problem: Obsidian stores images as local vault attachments, which bloats the vault and breaks when notes are synced or shared; there is no built-in way to rehost images on your own image bed.

requires.name: auth code or API token with upload permission

summary: Image uploader that sends pictures to a self-hosted CloudFlare ImgBed service, replacing local links with hosted Markdown image links.
